text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove is totally disheartened by Silence Suzuka's overwhelming abilities. I open a dialogue with her in the hopes of getting her back on her feet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell Air Groove that I see her as a challenger—someone who continually challenges herself to become the ideal for all Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As if to punctuate these words, she sees the fruits of her labors in Mejiro Dober, who works tirelessly with Air Groove as her ideal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Realizing that no matter how high the wall in her path, she must simply continue facing up to it, Air Groove stands resolute once more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now we can truly focus on the Sapporo Kinen, where Air Groove must show the world that the ideal she represents as Empress lives on!
